excluded_exploratory_pilot.purpose: API and boundary reconnaissance only; never eligible for formal holdout acceptance

main_cross_fidelity_holdout.scope: same four model lanes at disjoint squeezing points and fresh effective-model seeds; no threshold retuning

secondary_psteane_holdout.scope: secondary small-noise analytic regression only; no sBs ranking, physical squeezing, FPGA, or device claim

claim_boundary.allowed: independent cross-fidelity holdout outcomes exactly as observed and secondary small-noise P-Steane analytic regression
claim_boundary.forbidden: reselecting holdout points, hiding a failed family, promoting P-Steane into sBs ranking, physical squeezing implementation, device fidelity, FPGA, or hardware claims
